description.short: Supplier spend, price and savings analysis for restaurant and hotel groups
description.full:
Eqolux reads the supplier invoices, delivery notes and credit notes of restaurant and hotel groups and turns them into structured purchase data. This agent, designed for Microsoft 365 Copilot, lets you ask questions about that data in plain language, in Copilot Chat, Microsoft Teams and the Microsoft 365 apps. Answers come with links to the products, documents and suppliers in Eqolux.

**Who it is for**: purchasing managers, chefs, controllers and general managers of restaurant and hotel groups that use Eqolux.

**What you can do**
- See spend by supplier, establishment, product category and month.
- Follow product prices over time and find the same product bought at very different prices.
- Find purchases above a negotiated price, and see where products come from and their estimated carbon footprint.

**Requirements and limits**
- An Eqolux account is required. It comes with your organization's Eqolux subscription; to get one, write to hello@eqolux.com. You sign in with your Eqolux credentials the first time the agent reads your data.
- The agent only reads data: it cannot create or change anything in Eqolux.
- Answers are limited to the organizations, establishments, suppliers, documents and product categories your Eqolux account can access, one organization at a time.
- Each question covers one period of up to ten years. Without a period, the agent uses the last 12 months.
- Answers are generated by AI and can contain mistakes: check important figures in Eqolux. Savings figures are estimates computed from the documents Eqolux has read.
- The listing is available in English and French; the agent answers in the language of the question.

**Support**: write to support@eqolux.com, including to report an inaccurate or inappropriate answer.

localizationKeys.DA_DESCRIPTION: Answers questions about the purchasing data of restaurant and hotel groups in Eqolux: spend by supplier, establishment, category and month, product prices and their evolution, savings opportunities, purchases above negotiated prices, origins and carbon footprint. Read-only, and limited to what your Eqolux account can access.
